description: Shared Renovate defaults for shuricksumy's repositories

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: patch bumps and digest pins merge themselves when CI is green
Container images: digest refreshes (OS security rebuilds) and pins merge themselves when CI is green
Compose files are mostly examples people copy: keep plain tags there, pin digests only in Dockerfiles
Own images are built by these repositories; a digest pin on them would open a PR after every build
